recognize_zh: 周邊血液中央有一大團血小板聚集，周圍紅血球之間也散在許多單顆血小板，整體血小板數量偏多；左下角的嗜中性球形態正常，紅血球無明顯異常，符合原發性血小板增多症的血小板增多與聚集。
features: Large platelet aggregate in the center of the field
Numerous single platelets scattered between red cells, apparently increased
Platelets of variable size with well-granulated centers
Normocytic, normochromic red cells in rouleaux-like overlap from thick area
Mature segmented neutrophil at lower left without dysplasia
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows normocytic, normochromic red cells without significant poikilocytosis. Platelets are increased, with numerous single platelets of variable size and a large central platelet aggregate. A mature segmented neutrophil is present; no blasts, teardrop cells or nucleated red cells are seen. Platelet clumping can reflect in vitro aggregation, so the platelet count should be interpreted with the smear and repeated in citrate if clumping is extensive. Findings are consistent with thrombocytosis compatible with essential thrombocythemia in the appropriate clinical and molecular context.

ddx.vs: Artifactual clumps occur with a normal or falsely low count and resolve in citrate, whereas here abundant single platelets also indicate true thrombocytosis.
Reactive thrombocytosis shows similar platelets; distinction requires clinical context and JAK2/CALR/MPL testing.
PV also causes thrombocytosis but is defined by an increased hemoglobin/red cell mass and JAK2 mutation, with crowded red cells.
